en: This postcard features a historic European market square surrounded by ornate buildings in a small town. The foreground shows a statue or monument with steps and lampposts, while several people and a horse-drawn carriage are visible in the square. The background contains a ridge with houses. At the top, text says 'Sebnitz. (Sächs. Schweiz.) Markt.' There's also a sign on one of the buildings reading 'HOTEL STADT DRESDEN'. The numbers and publisher at the bottom right read '10378 Brück & Sohn, Meissen'.
